execution_policy.postfit_freeze: Bind actual native checkpoint hashes to the prefit commitment before collection; never use placeholder hashes as completed acceptance plans.

blueprint_sampling.dropout: Select a bounded exogenous mask before rolling out either role; no filtering by truth, carry witnesses or accuracy ceiling
blueprint_sampling.initial_bits: Independent fair binary draws before mode selection
blueprint_sampling.sensor_coverage: All physical IDs selected; realized missingness is explicit

information_law.deduplication: Canonical blueprint and reversed view ancestry; selected without hidden mode, complete truth or future delivered values
information_law.feedback: Noiseless delivered bits; absent values remain absent
information_law.mode_persistence: One source slot per physical draw; shared by its reversed views and fixed through every contact
information_law.oracle: Enumerate every persistent mode compatible with delivered past before revealing current feedback
information_law.scheduling: Actions, coverage, realized masks and identity labels selected before and independently of actual hidden mode

reporting.carry: Audit actual counterfactual dependence; do not select or drop cases using its result
reporting.ceiling_scope: Expected accuracy under the declared law, not a hard upper bound on a finite realized sample
reporting.law_audit: Equal prior mass for both counterfactual persistent modes of every fixed blueprint; probability mass aggregated before computing scores
reporting.map_ties: First lexicographic complete world, matching acceptance-v1
reporting.prediction_points: Every planned action before its feedback
reporting.primary_diagnostic: All-planned complete-world accuracy; separate contact, family, answerable and ambiguous strata
reporting.trajectory_and_pair: Conjunction on coherent histories, never product of marginal ceilings

information_law.conditioning: delivered observations before prediction, past/current actions and selected coverage only
information_law.contact: source = participants[mode]; target = participants[1-mode]; target ^= source
information_law.design: actions, selected coverage, missingness and opaque IDs are exogenous to hidden mode and outcomes

hidden_source_slot.persistence: one fixed mode for the whole episode

information_law.initial_anchor: complete, noiseless, independent of hidden source slot
information_law.readings: noiseless visible binary values; null is absent evidence
information_law.scope: evaluator-only law-conditional probabilities; no independent-custody or model-performance claim
information_law.self_contact: one physical coordinate; its GF(2) sum with itself is zero
information_law.set: replace exactly the named coordinate with the supplied binary value
information_law.world_order: lexicographic binary vectors in sorted physical-ID order

environment_preflight.model_tensor_dtype: CPU torch.float64 for native learned predictors; torch default dtype is reported separately.
environment_preflight.scope: Standalone frozen-input preflight environment; not per-model benchmark measurements.

focused_local_suite.scope: All 37 new oracle, generator, audit, observed-input and integration invariant tests; final full suite independently includes them.

generated_assets.archive_contents: Complete bundle (strict observed inputs, separate evaluator gold and metadata, source/config identities) plus full audit, compressed with deterministic XZ CRC64.

evaluation_in_family_ceiling.scope: Conditional expectation over equiprobable persistent modes for every accepted evaluation in-family blueprint; not a hard bound on one finite realized sample and not measured neural accuracy.

law_weighted_audit.carry_interpretation: Suppress one earlier contact and compare the later contact destination; unrelated surviving bystander differences do not count.
law_weighted_audit.case_details_location: audit.json:cases, also in checked-in archive audit; omitted here to avoid duplicating 624 case records
law_weighted_audit.ceiling_interpretation: Expected under both equiprobable persistent modes, not a hard bound on a finite realized sample.
law_weighted_audit.conjunction_interpretation: Frozen lexicographic MAP with delivered feedback; not an optimal trajectory/pair policy ceiling.
law_weighted_audit.detailed_strata_location: Full by-split/by-family answerable and ambiguous conditional-law strata and target diagnostics remain in the hash-bound audit.json and archive. This record retains aggregate, split and evaluation-family summaries.
law_weighted_audit.pair_tie_caveat: A balanced unidentified reversed pair can have zero conjunction credit even for exact calibrated forecasts.
law_weighted_audit.resource_interpretation: Conservative dense-support history counts without merging; no measured model cost or oracle pruning.
law_weighted_audit.scope: Exact conditional-law engineering audit of public same-author assets; no research result.
law_weighted_audit.selection_policy: All supplied cases retained regardless of ambiguity, carry witnesses or resource limits.

generated_assets.observed_exposure_scope: Raw delivered event/bit and immediately preceding/subsequent complete-reading counts. These do not establish equally eligible history-based targets, equal learner capacity or equal consumed compute across arms.
generated_assets.participant_boundary: Only observed inputs and native checkpoint enter the participant. Combined archive, audit, oracle and hidden case metadata stay on the evaluator side.
generated_assets.repeated_template_interpretation: Blueprint and lineage disjointness does not imply every action template, atomic context or prefix is novel.

limitations.export_atomicity: Pre-validation occurs before destination creation and the completion manifest is written last; an I/O failure can leave a newly created incomplete directory without the manifest.
limitations.fixed_map_conjunctions: Lexicographic-MAP trajectory and role-pair values describe the frozen point-decision rule, not an optimal coherent joint-policy ceiling. Exact calibrated distributions can receive zero pair conjunction credit in an ambiguous reversed pair.
limitations.full_comparison_freeze: Arm configurations, selection/calibration, eligible-target exposure, capacity/compute matching, effect sizes, inference units and multiplicity remain to be frozen before research fitting.
limitations.law_weighted_not_learned_results: No research model was fitted or scored. The 85.6287% evaluation in-family ceiling quantifies the previously known first-contact ambiguity on fresh assets, not a trained-model regression.
limitations.proposal_vs_accepted_distribution: Blueprint rejection happens before hidden-mode choice and can alter accepted initial-state/topology/mask frequencies. Audit conditions on accepted blueprints; proposal probabilities are not claimed as accepted frequencies.
limitations.resource_estimates: Conservative dense histories without merging and before-feedback candidate expansions, not measured model runtime, memory cost or oracle pruning.
limitations.sampling_units: Reversed views, action steps and counterfactual mode branches are correlated. The 624 views arise from 328 physical draws; model seeds and physical worlds are distinct replication dimensions.
limitations.scientific_admission: No G1 admission, unseen entity-count transfer, independent challenge result or language/G2 promotion follows from this engineering validation.
limitations.scope_of_oracle_completeness: Complete only for the declared balanced persistent two-mode binary-contact law and noiseless exogenous observation design. Independent authentication of that law, authorship and custody remains pending.
limitations.size_goal: The active source count is 3344 physical lines excluding frozen dependencies; the inclusive 2000-line goal is not met.
limitations.statistics: Five paired model seeds alone give minimum two-sided exact sign-flip p = 2/32 = 0.0625; no new statistical acceptance framework was implemented.

new_capabilities.observed_io.py: Hash-bound observed-only input conversion to existing ObservedBatch, grouped by entity count and action length without temporal padding or hidden-target filling; no generator/oracle import.
new_capabilities.prospective_audit.py: Exact inventory/topology/source validation; law-weighted event ceilings and proper-score floors; coherent fixed-policy trajectory/pair conjunctions; conservative dense resource counts; genuine later-contact carry witnesses.
new_capabilities.prospective_data.py: Frozen fresh four-way assets, original physical law and family topologies, exogenous bounded missingness, no intervening reset, reversed-view coupling, canonical blueprint and lineage disjointness, deterministic export and manifest.
new_capabilities.prospective_oracle.py: Evaluator-only exact conditional support and probabilities from the delivered prefix; preserves persistent modes through world coalescence; no simulator or learner import.

new_test_coverage.integration_checks: Actual default CLI export and no overwrite; deterministic smaller exports and byte hashes; all four observed splits load; join to existing acceptance contract with a real native no-change checkpoint under SYNTHETIC_INVARIANTS; empty traces remain UNPRODUCED.
new_test_coverage.neural_check_scope: Untrained replay parity with the existing participant, not learned research-model evaluation.
new_test_coverage.oracle_checks: Original simulator parity for every binary state/legal action; all sensor masks on multi-step histories; persistent-mode correlations, coalescence, aliases and current/future-feedback exclusion.
